_comment: Copy to streams.json (install.sh does it for you) and put your own links in. streams.json is gitignored: stream links stay on the Pi, never in the repo. Each button needs "url" for one link, or "urls" for several - a button with several steps to the next one each time you tap it. "links" is separate: those open on your own phone for browsing, not on the TV. See README.
